note: Seven scripts, 4-6 turns each, where later turns depend on earlier ones. Every word is one Droso owns (verified against word_patterns before writing this file). 'say' turns are told to him and never graded; 'ask' turns are graded mechanically: any_of = at least one of these words in his reply, must_contain = all of them, must_not_contain = none of them. The winner among conflicting facts is recorded, never graded -- which fact he answers with is a finding about recency, not a fault.

scripts.name: reference
scripts.note: The question refers to earlier content by its predicate and time; the answer must name the subject I mentioned. Two independent pairs so one lucky hit cannot carry the script.

scripts.name: accumulation
scripts.note: Three facts about one subject, then two questions. The second question depends on the third tell, so a pass means the last-heard fact was still reachable.

turns.say: the box is on the shelf

scripts.name: discrimination
scripts.note: Contrasting predicates on two subjects, no cross-over. A pass requires the right predicate for the right subject AND the absence of the wrong one.

scripts.name: role_chain
scripts.note: A does X to B; B does Y to A. The who-questions reverse the roles, so an answer that merely echoes a heard name fails.

scripts.name: switch_back
scripts.note: Fact on A, two facts on B, then ask about both. The question about A comes after two turns about B, so a pass means A's fact survived the interleaving.

scripts.name: override
scripts.note: Same subject, conflicting predicates. Which predicate wins is recorded per run and reported, never graded: the nondeterminism IS the finding. Graded only on the answer being a session predicate rather than something from training memory.

scripts.name: session_context
scripts.note: Two tells share one subject and one predicate; only the modifier and the time differ. The reference tell (kettle rings at noon) is taught first, then the new tell (iron kettle shines at dawn). Each ask is graded on the new pair AND on the absence of the other tell's words, so an answer from the wrong tell fails and a blend of the two fails: recency is the thing under test, and which tell he answered from is visible in the recorded reply.

turns.say: the iron kettle shines at dawn

scripts.name: where_kept
scripts.note: The debt log's entry-5 residual shape: a where-question whose subject is not its last token ('where is the box kept' -- 'kept' is a content verb after the copula). The parser takes only the first content token after the copula as the subject; the ranking's where-case takes the candidate's last token as the filler; the locative matcher requires a preposition. The state tell on the box tests the preposition veto under this shape too (accumulation tests it only subject-final).

turns.say: the box is kept on the shelf
the coat is kept in the closet
